evidence_spans.snippet: BH1750FVI is an digital Ambient Light Sensor IC for I2C bus interface.
It is possible to select 2 type of I2C slave-address.
H-Resolution Mode Measurement Time tHR - 120 180 ms
L-Resolution Mode Measurement Time tLR - 16 24 ms
Data Register → This is for registration of Ambient Light Data. Initial Value is "0000_0000_0000_0000".
Power On 0000_0001 Waiting for measurement command.
Reset command is for only reset Illuminance data register. ( reset value is '0' )
The below formula is to calculate illuminance per 1 count.
H-reslution mode : Illuminance per 1 count ( lx / count )  = 1 / 1.2 *( 69 / X )
DVI Terminal is also asynchronous Reset for internal registers.

requires_human: Confirm whether the target board should default ADDR to GND (0x23) or VCC (0x5C); the datasheet states two legal addresses but does not define a silicon factory-default strap state for ADDR.
The datasheet presents separate high-bit and low-bit MTreg write opcodes; confirm whether the driver should expose MTreg adjustment as a public configuration API or keep it internal-only.
